title: French-Style Pancit Stir Fry
description: A unique fusion of French and Filipino flavors in this easy-to-make pancit stir fry. Serve with a side of crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the winey in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the filipino and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the xenial and cook for another minute.
Add the noodles and cook for 3-4 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the pancit and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: add protein of your choice, such as chicken or shrimp, for added flavor.
